mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recharge_order (order_no, user_id, amount, bonus, channel, status, expire_at) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{amount}, #{bonus}, #{channel}, #{status}, #{expireAt})

where.if: AND (o.order_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR u.username ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR u.real_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')

mapper.select:
SELECT o.id AS "id", o.order_no AS "orderNo", o.user_id AS "userId", u.username AS "username", u.real_name AS "realName", o.amount AS "amount", o.bonus AS "bonus", o.channel AS "channel", o.status AS "status", o.created_at AS "createdAt", o.expire_at AS "expireAt", o.paid_at AS "paidAt" FROM recharge_order o JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = o.user_id
ORDER BY ${sortCol} ${sortDir}, o.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM recharge_order o JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = o.user_id
mapper.update: UPDATE recharge_order SET status = 'PAID', paid_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING' AND expire_at > now()
UPDATE recharge_order SET status = 'CANCELLED' WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: UPDATE recharge_order SET status = 'EXPIRED' WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND expire_at <= now() RETURNING *
